description: Machine-checkable structural data validation against EXPLICITLY DECLARED metadata/rules. V1 supports: (a) declared-key duplicate detection; (b) selected-variable missingness counts/rates; (c) row-count / observation-count consistency; (d) required-variable presence + declared type consistency; (e) sample-flow arithmetic consistency; (f) merge cardinality (1:1 / 1:m / m:1) ONLY when a merge + expected relationship is explicitly declared. It does NOT infer economically reasonable ranges/units automatically, does NOT decide sample exclusions, does NOT impute/delete/recode or repair data, and does NOT substitute validation for scientific judgment.

references.name: DIME Data Handbook (World Bank) - data management / documentation / reproducibility
DIME Wiki - Data Management (deduplication, documentation, data cleaning discipline)

methodology.note: Structural, machine-checkable data validation. The capability consumes frozen data + explicit declared metadata/rules; it does NOT decide substantive sample exclusions, units, or ranges automatically. No automatic cleaning/reparation is performed.

verification.evidence: Tested for the exact demonstrated scope: read-only pandas structural validation of the accepted frozen Grunfeld real dataset against its declared rules (key=firm+year, N=200; checks DV_ROWCOUNT / DV_VAR_PRESENT / DV_VAR_TYPE / DV_KEY_UNIQUE / DV_MISSINGNESS / DV_SAMPLE_FLOW pass; DV_MERGE_CARDINALITY not_applicable for a single frozen dataset), plus deterministic adversarial defect detection (duplicate key, missing variable, unexpected missingness, row-count mismatch, wrong declared type, bad rule key, invalid merge cardinality -> each surfaces as FAIL). Does NOT impute/delete/repair data; does NOT infer ranges/units. NOT verified; NOT generic data cleaning; NOT automatic sample exclusion.

Tested for the exact demonstrated scope: base-Stata read-only structural validation of the accepted frozen Grunfeld real dataset (DV_ROWCOUNT / DV_VAR_PRESENT / DV_VAR_TYPE / DV_KEY_UNIQUE / DV_MISSINGNESS / DV_SAMPLE_FLOW pass; DV_MERGE_CARDINALITY not_applicable). Cross-engine agreement with data.val.python.pandas (same 6 pass / 0 fail / 1 not_applicable; same frozen checksum). ieduplicates/iecodebook are installed, but the demonstrated scope is the base-Stata structural checks. Does NOT impute/delete/repair; does NOT infer ranges/units. NOT verified; NOT generic data cleaning; NOT automatic sample exclusion.
